method: Read-only source audit. HEAD was read with git rev-parse. All eight routes, both extracted screen bodies, every management section, current client contracts and the effective defining sports SQL functions were read. No app, SQL, CI, settings or production changes; no tests, builds, installations, commits, pushes, deployments or subagents.
scopeNotes: The draft implementation plan supplied WP names and intended ownership only; findings below are independently grounded in the frozen source.
Source-backed means a branch or data dependency exists in code, not that an interaction was executed.

Class A fixes apply with Oorva presentation OFF. Class C composition uses the proposed, not currently registered, oorva_sports_ux leaf under oorva_brand and also respects the actual sports capability switches.

New migration filenames use coordinator-substituted execution claim tokens: SP-T01=<MIG-SQL-V>_oorva_sports_review_guards.sql; SP-T06=<MIG-SQL-SP>_oorva_sports_public_projection.sql; SP-T11=<MIG-SQL-SC>_oorva_sports_legacy_capacity.sql. Numeric version UNASSIGNED until shared coordinator acknowledgment. Tokens are execution metadata, not permission to guess max(main)+1; active/uncommitted claims are unknown. Applied historical migration filenames remain source evidence, not edit targets.
No new cancellation, refund, commission, payment-mode, suspension-maintenance or staff-management policy is proposed.

Sports venue review is present. A sports customer-review/rating lifecycle is not represented by the existing reviews table, which references public.bookings and providers; no sports review CTA is proposed.
